mapper.select: SELECT SUM(day1.show_pv) AS show_pv, SUM(day1.click_pv) AS click_pv, SUM(day1.req_pv) AS req_pv, SUM(day1.discard) AS discard, SUM(day1.ret_pv) AS ret_pv, SUM(day1.spend) AS spend, SUM(day1.income) AS income, SUM(day1.discount_click_pv) AS discount_click_pv, SUM(day1.discount_show_pv) AS discount_show_pv, SUM(day1.dplsucc_pv) AS dplsucc_pv, SUM(day1.complete_pv) AS complete_pv, SUM(day1.install_pv) AS install_pv, SUM(day1.activate_pv) AS activate_pv FROM data_dsp_slot_day day1 WHERE day1.date BETWEEN #{date[0]} AND #{date[1]}

SELECT day.*, com.name AS companyName, pro.name AS productName,dsp.name AS dspName FROM data_dsp_slot_day AS day LEFT JOIN dsp_slot_info AS dsp ON dsp.id = day.dsp_slot_id LEFT JOIN dsp_company AS com ON dsp.company_id = com.id LEFT JOIN dsp_product AS pro ON dsp.product_id = pro.id WHERE day.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND day.date = #{date} ORDER BY day.id DESC

SELECT d.*,dsp.name as dspName, ssp.name AS sspName, com.name as companyName, product.name as productName,media.media_company_short as media_name FROM data_dsp_slot_day AS d LEFT JOIN dsp_slot_info AS dsp ON d.dsp_slot_id = dsp.id LEFT JOIN ssp_slot_info AS ssp ON d.ssp_slot_id = ssp.id LEFT JOIN dsp_company AS com ON dsp.company_id = com.id LEFT JOIN dsp_company AS product on dsp.product_id = product.id LEFT JOIn ssp_app AS app on ssp.app_id = app.id LEFT JOIN ssp_media AS media on ssp.media_id = media.id WHERE d.dsp_slot_code = #{dspSlotCode} AND d.date = #{inputTime} AND d.dsp_slot_id = #{dspSlotId} AND d.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.id DESC

SELECT com.id AS company_id, com.name AS companyName, SUM(day.show_pv) AS showPv, SUM(day.click_pv) AS clickPv, SUM(day.req_pv) AS reqPv, SUM(day.discard) AS discard, SUM(day.ret_pv) AS retPv, SUM(day.spend) AS spend, SUM(day.income) AS income, SUM(day.discount_click_pv) AS discountClickPv, SUM(day.discount_show_pv) AS discountShowPv, SUM(day.dplsucc_pv) AS dplsuccPv, SUM(day.complete_pv) AS completePv, SUM(day.install_pv) AS installPv, SUM(day.activate_pv) AS activatePv, #{date} AS date FROM data_dsp_slot_day day INNER JOIN dsp_slot_info slot ON slot.id = day.dsp_slot_id AND slot.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN dsp_company com ON com.id = slot.company_id AND com.deleted = 0 WHERE day.date = #{date} AND day.deleted = 0 GROUP BY com.id, com.name ORDER BY com.id
